admission.justification: Binds reads, previews and dry runs to file no per-call report: only an executed mutating action files one.

alternatives.option: Diagnostic reads, watcher status, install dry-run previews and carryover plans carry content answers with no reportPath; executed mutations file their report.
alternatives.reason: A per-call report on every read would turn the tool Reports dir into unreadable noise and hide the executed actions that matter.

alternatives.option: File a per-call report for every read, preview and dry run.
alternatives.reason: Buries executed-action reports in noise and hides what matters.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Per-call reports gain a governed retention and triage owner.

consequences: Future tool builders keep rule-6(c) filing: preview answers carry markers, not report pointers.
context: Worker P13: reads, previews and dry runs file no per-call temp/tool-reports report.
